strongest_angle: Break down the October 2026 guidance published by Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra through Harvard Law School's Program on Negotiation regarding four key concession strategies.

key_facts.fact: Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra published guidance through Harvard Law School's Program on Negotiation on October 14th, 2026 outlining four strategies for making concessions.
key_facts.source_name: Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

key_facts.fact: Deepak Malhotra originally detailed the four concession strategies to build goodwill and reciprocity in negotiations as published by Harvard Business School Working Knowledge.
Katie Shonk authored guidance on August 4th, 2026 for Harvard Law School's Program on Negotiation regarding best practices for making concessions in negotiations.
key_facts.source_name: Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

quotes.text: Concessions are often necessary in negotiation, says HBS professor Deepak Malhotra. But they often go unappreciated and unreciprocated.
quotes.speaker: Deepak Malhotra
